findings.title: Complete Unauthenticated API Access
findings.description: Zero authentication middleware. Every route — CRUD, workflow transitions, intake, Prometheus — accessible to any unauthenticated HTTP client.
findings.remediation: Implement global requireAuth middleware before all route mounts in index.ts/app.ts using JWT Bearer tokens. Single fix neutralises C-001 through H-005.

findings.title: Force-Approve Bypasses Entire Voting Gate (State Machine Bypass)
findings.description: POST /force-approve transitions any item to approved status skipping all AI voting and human review. FR with DENY majority force-approved unauthenticated.
findings.remediation: Gate /force-approve and route override behind authenticated HUMAN_REVIEWER role. Log to immutable audit trail. Require minimum vote threshold for manual overrides.

findings.title: Unauthenticated Hard Delete — Permanent Data Destruction + Sequential ID Reuse
findings.description: DELETE endpoints permanently destroy records with no auth and no confirmation. Sequential IDs reused after deletion — attacker records replace deleted ones, hijacking stale references.
findings.remediation: Require authentication. Default to soft-delete (deleted_at timestamp); reserve hard delete for elevated admin role. Require ?confirm=true for permanent deletion.

findings.title: Unbounded Pagination — Full Dataset Dump
findings.description: ?limit=999999, ?limit=0, and omitting limit all return entire dataset. 55 FRs returned in single unauthenticated request.
findings.remediation: const limit = Math.min(parsed, 100) in all list routes. Default 20. HTTP 400 if requested limit exceeds max. Apply to all list endpoints.

findings.title: Vote Retrigger Farming — Unlimited Re-Roll (Assessment Bypass)
findings.description: POST /retrigger re-runs AI voting with no auth, no rate limit, no cap. Attacker loops until desired outcome then calls /approve.
findings.remediation: Require auth for retrigger. Rate-limit to max 1/FR/hour. Record full vote history. Consider deterministic vote seeding per FR ID.

findings.title: Dependency DoS — Deleted Blocker Permanently Locks Dependent
findings.description: computeHasUnresolvedBlockers() treats missing (deleted) blocker as unresolved — permanently blocking dependent dispatch. No recovery path. Deleted item ID leaked.
findings.remediation: On blocker delete, cascade-remove stale dependency links or set deleted items to resolved sentinel. Fix computeHasUnresolvedBlockers() to treat undefined as resolved.

findings.title: Deny Feature Request Without Voting (Skip Entire Review)
findings.description: POST /deny transitions FR directly from potential to denied without voting phase. No auth, no audit record.
findings.remediation: Restrict /deny to authenticated HUMAN_REVIEWER role. Require override flag + audit event for denial from potential. Require at least one vote round before human denial.

findings.title: Stored XSS + Unvalidated Enum Input
findings.description: Title/description fields store raw HTML including
findings.remediation: Apply server-side HTML sanitization (DOMPurify or sanitize-html) on all user-controlled text before persistence. Apply enum validation to intake routes. Frontend must use textContent, not innerHTML.

findings.title: Unauthenticated Intake Webhooks — No HMAC Signature Verification
findings.description: Zendesk and automated intake endpoints accept arbitrary payloads without HMAC verification. Any caller can forge Zendesk events or flood the work item queue.
findings.remediation: Verify X-Zendesk-Webhook-Signature-256 via pre-shared secret env var. Require bearer token for /api/intake/automated. Enforce 5 req/min rate limit.

findings.title: Rejection Cascade Auto-Dispatches Dependents (Business Logic Flaw)
findings.description: DISPATCH_TRIGGER_STATUSES includes Rejected — rejecting a blocker auto-dispatches approved dependents to in-progress even though the prerequisite failed.
findings.remediation: Remove Rejected from DISPATCH_TRIGGER_STATUSES. Rejected blockers should move dependents to blocked/pending-review, not dispatch them.

findings.title: Missing Required Audit Log Events
findings.description: Three of four required events absent: login_attempt, permission_denied, data_export. state_transition partially captured but lacks actor identity, source IP, correlation ID.
findings.remediation: Implement auditLog() helper with event, actor, resource, sourceIp, traceId, outcome. Emit from all workflow handlers. Once auth exists, emit login/permission events.

findings.title: No TLS/HTTPS Enforcement
findings.description: Application listens on plain HTTP. No TLS termination, no HTTPS redirect, no HSTS. Future credential tokens would transmit in cleartext.
findings.remediation: Configure TLS at reverse proxy (nginx/Caddy). Add helmet() with HSTS. Enforce X-Forwarded-Proto: https check.

findings.title: Unauthenticated Prometheus Metrics Disclosure
findings.description: GET /metrics returns 78 metric lines including status transitions, AI vote counts, heap size, GC stats, event loop lag to any unauthenticated caller. Full technology fingerprint exposed.
findings.remediation: Restrict /metrics to internal network via reverse proxy or require static Bearer token.

findings.title: Search Empty Query Returns Full Dataset
findings.description: GET /api/search?q= and GET /api/search (no param) return 20-item datasets. Entire dataset walkable via empty-query pagination with no auth.
findings.remediation: Return HTTP 400 for missing or empty q. Enforce minimum query length of 2 characters. Apply authentication.

findings.title: CI/CD Workflow inputs.focus Free-Text Shell Injection Risk
findings.description: inputs.focus workflow_dispatch parameter injected into YAML before shell execution. Combined with --dangerously-skip-permissions on Claude Code, crafted value could alter prompt file.
findings.remediation: Validate inputs.focus against explicit allowlist. Tighten --allowedTools on Claude Code invocations.

findings.title: Docker Containers Run as Root
findings.description: All three Dockerfiles lack USER directives. Worker container runs Claude Code with --dangerously-skip-permissions and mounts Docker socket — root compromise gives host Docker daemon access.
findings.remediation: Add non-root user to each Dockerfile: RUN groupadd -r appuser && useradd -r -g appuser appuser && USER appuser.

findings.title: Missing HTTP Security Headers + No CORS Policy
findings.description: No helmet — missing CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, HSTS, Referrer-Policy. No CORS — any web page can make cross-origin requests.
findings.remediation: npm install helmet cors; apply before all routes: app.use(helmet()); app.use(cors({ origin: ['http://localhost:5173'], credentials: true })).

findings.title: Negative Page Parameter Reads Unexpected Data Positions
findings.description: Negative page values produce negative offsets passed to Array.slice(), returning data from unexpected positions. ?page=-1 returns items near end of list.
findings.remediation: Validate page >= 1 and limit >= 1 at route layer; return HTTP 400 otherwise.

findings.title: No Rate Limiting on Any Endpoint
findings.description: No rate-limit middleware. All endpoints callable at unlimited frequency. Retrigger farming (RED-003) looped with no throttling.
findings.remediation: Add express-rate-limit: 100/min general, 20/min workflow mutations, 5/min intake webhooks, 1/hr for retrigger.

findings.title: No GDPR Right to Erasure (Hard Delete Path Missing)
findings.description: DELETE performs soft-delete only. No purge path. When a database is added, PII in title/description will persist indefinitely.
findings.remediation: Implement purgeWorkItem() with DELETE /api/work-items/:id?permanent=true requiring elevated auth. Document data retention policy.

findings.title: Internal Orchestrator URL Disclosed in Error Response
findings.description: GET /api/orchestrator/test returns HTTP 502 with body revealing http://localhost:8080. Internal network topology disclosed unauthenticated.
findings.remediation: Return generic 'Service temporarily unavailable'. Log actual target URL server-side only.

findings.title: Predictable Sequential DocIDs Enable Enumeration
findings.description: Sequential WI-NNN/FR-NNNN docIds reveal total usage, activity rates, and enable cross-referencing of soft-deleted IDs from dependency records.
findings.remediation: Use UUIDs or cryptographically random ID segments for externally visible IDs.

findings.title: No CORS / No CSRF Protection
findings.description: No CORS policy, no CSRF token mechanism. Not directly exploitable now (no session) but any cookie-based auth addition without these controls is immediately exploitable.
findings.remediation: See M-005 for CORS. Add csurf or SameSite=Strict cookie policy once session auth is introduced.

findings.title: Raw Exception Messages Forwarded to Clients
findings.description: Individual route catch blocks forward err.message directly to clients. Global errorHandler correctly returns generic messages — per-route inconsistency.
findings.remediation: Standardize all route catches to return generic user-facing messages. Only propagate pre-approved UserError subclasses. Log full errors server-side.

findings.title: No Data Retention Policy / No Scheduled Purge
findings.description: Soft-deleted items accumulate indefinitely. When persistence is added, all records including PII in descriptions will be retained forever.
findings.remediation: Define retention policy (soft-deleted purged after 90 days, completed archived after 1 year). Implement scheduled purge job.
